model: In my opinion, it's better to buy a home in the long run, although renting makes sense while you're young. First, buying gives you security. When you rent, you can be asked to leave, and the rent can go up at any time. My sister rented for five years in Hanoi and had to move three times due to landlords selling their flats, which led to a lot of stress. Once she took out a mortgage, she finally felt she could put down roots. Another reason is that property is a long-term investment. House prices in big Vietnamese cities have risen steadily, which means that owners build wealth while renters are, in a way, throwing money away on rent. Of course, saving for a down payment is hard, and buying too early can leave you tied down if you want to change jobs. But as a consequence of rising prices, waiting too long can make it even harder to get on the property ladder. So overall, I'd say buy when you're settled.
